subject: general
question: A number when divided by 78 gives the quotient 280 and the remainder 0. If the same number is divided by 65, what will be the value of the remainder?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the number is 280 × 78 

Now divide the number by 65

⇒ 280 × 78 / 65 = 336

 If we divide the quotient is 336 

So if it is divisible by 65 the remainder will be 0
